name: hovercard4
blurb: Blog post card with image zoom and animated CTA arrow.
description: A card with featured image and blog metadata (date, title, CTA link). Image zooms on hover; CTA arrow animates from single to double chevron.
use_when: Blog listing pages, article teasers, or content cards where image zoom and CTA emphasis guide readers.
avoid_when: Touch-only layouts where zoom/animation could create persistent visual noise.
a11y: Image has alt text; CTA link is keyboard accessible. Arrow animation is visual feedback only.
